messages:
alex: Heads-up: post-merge perf regression noticed on canary. p95 decode up ~30% for chat-gen workloads after merge github.com/redwood/infra@f3a9c2b (PR #4821). CI perf job 'runtime-decode-p95' failed.

maria: saw the CI alert. link: https://ci.redwood/dev/runs/4821. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 160ms.

sam: assigning bisect. @kevin can you run local bisect on the canary image? suspect kernel selector flip or fused reshape ordering.

kevin: running bisection now. quick profiler snapshot shows extra memcpy in attention path when batch shapes have ragged seq lengths. snippet:
```
kernel_selector: chosen=attn_opt_v2 reshape_fused=true
nvprof timeline: memcpy HtoD 4.2ms -> kernel attn_v2 8.3ms
```

julian: also seeing increased KV cache misses. Maybe reshape fuse altered KV layout; prefetch heuristic no longer hits. p95 spike correlates with long-context requests.

perf-bot: perf-regression-detected: runtime-decode-p95 >= +25% (threshold 15%). Blocking rollout.

alex: can we get a minimal reproducer? I put a small script in /tmp/repro.sh that sends mixed-length chat requests. @maria please run against canary and previous commit.

maria: repro confirmed. previous commit f2b8... shows 118ms p95, current f3a9c2b shows 160ms. Heap profile and nvprof attached (pasted below). Key diff: kernel_selector now prefers attn_fused_reshape for sequences > 128.

sam: hypothesis: fused reshape changes tensor strides so KV prefetch heuristic (which looks for contiguous layout) misses; runtime falls back to memcopy-based path. Two mitigation paths: 1) ensure selector penalizes reshape_fused variant for long contexts; 2) fix KV prefetch to handle new layout.

kevin: quick patch in branch fix/kernel-selector-penalty reduces p95 back to 122ms in local repro. will open PR with benchmark results.

julian: +1 for selector tweak as short term. long term we should make KV prefetch layout-agnostic.

alex: plan: hold rollout, revert merge if PR not ready in 2 hours. @sam coordinate rollback if needed.

sam: creating hotfix PR and running CI perf with canary harness. tagging eng-runtime for review.

perf-bot: perf-ci-run: https://ci.redwood/dev/runs/4835 result: p95 124ms (within threshold). Non-regression verified.

maria: after hotfix patch merged, canary rollout resumed. monitoring dashboards show p95 returning to baseline. Leave follow-up ticket for KV prefetch improvements.

kevin: filing follow-up: #ISSUE-1742 "KV prefetch layout-agnostic prefetch + unit tests" with profiling artifacts.

alex: thanks all. add notes to release blockers doc and close thread when follow-up is triaged. :thumbsup:
